description: Foto de produto em estúdio, hero object, sem pessoa. Strip softbox key + card fill + flag subtractive. Uso: e-commerce premium, hero de landing page.

ask_before.prompt: Frase de abertura: tipo de produto, disposição na cena, superfície de apoio. Ex.: 'A men's mechanical wristwatch resting at a 15-degree tilt on a slab of honed dark grey slate'.
Lista de superfícies do produto, cada uma com acabamento (polished, brushed, matte, honed, coated_glass, leather, textile, painted, raw), resposta especular e — quando faz reflexo — o que reflete.
Cláusula de fechamento do bloco REFLECTION GEOMETRY, sempre no espírito de 'nothing in the reflections implies a light source that is not declared'.
Proporção. Recomendado 4:5 para hero vertical, 1:1 para carrossel, 16:9 para banner.

in_focus: the near face of the object
out_of_focus: the far edge of the surface softens progressively

camera.perspective_note: 120mm macro on medium format holds the object geometry without wide-angle distortion

optics.bokeh_character: progressive falloff behind the focal plane with no swirl at the frame edge

sources.modifier: 90 by 30 centimetre strip softbox overhead camera-left
sources.feathering: feathered so its reflection lands on the object as one continuous soft-edged white band running upper-left to lower-right, never a hotspot

penumbra.location: across the surface away from the object

lighting.shadow_direction: falls down and camera-right from the overhead key, consistent for every declared element
lighting.contact_shadow: The contact shadow under the object is tight and dense, opening into a soft penumbra across the surface
lighting.background_treatment: A black flag below the camera line deepens the near chamfer into a defined dark gradient

render.colour_profile: neutral digital profile, no film emulation
render.highlight_rolloff: Gradual highlight rolloff on the specular edges with no clipped whites
render.black_point: deepest shadow under the object near 5 percent luminance
render.grain: Very fine luminance grain consistent with ISO 100

frame.composition: Hero object centred with any trailing element leading toward the lower-right corner
frame.headroom: roughly 12 percent margin above the object

imperfection_budget.specific: A single mote of dust rests on the surface 3 centimetres from the object, just outside critical focus
One micro-scale manufacturing mark visible only in the specular band

defaults.capture_reality: A single frame from a commercial product session

example_answers.meta.user_request: foto de produto premium de um relógio de pulso mecânico para e-commerce de luxo
example_answers.scene.headline: Studio product photograph, single hero object. A men's mechanical wristwatch resting at a 15-degree tilt on a slab of honed dark grey slate, strap partly unfolded toward the camera

materials.surface: 40mm brushed stainless steel case with polished chamfered bezel edges
materials.specular_response: the radial brushing shows fine directional grain under the key light while the chamfers read as bright specular lines
materials.reflects: the polished bezel carries a legible, geometrically correct reflection of the strip light, while the brushed flanks scatter it into a broad directional sheen

materials.surface: deep blue sunburst dial with applied polished indices
materials.specular_response: the sunburst sheen rotates with the light angle, brightening along the radial grain
materials.reflects: the applied indices return a compressed image of the strip softbox
materials.typography: printed white minute track with crisp, correctly kerned typography

materials.specular_response: transmits cleanly with a faint blue-violet cast at glancing angle
materials.reflects: one continuous soft-edged band from the strip softbox, nothing else

materials.surface: vegetable-tanned brown leather strap with cream saddle stitching
materials.specular_response: broad diffuse scatter with micro-specular on the raised grain, darkening where the leather folds at the spring bars
materials.manufacturing_defect: one stitch sits fractionally tighter than its neighbours, and a hairline handling mark crosses the clasp, visible only in the specular band

materials.surface: slab of honed dark grey slate
materials.specular_response: returns a dim diffuse double, never a mirror image
materials.reflects: a dim diffuse double of the case, no legible detail

example_answers.reflection_closure: Nothing in the reflections implies a light source that is not declared
